messages.subject: Root by geom_rootedge()
parts:
Hi,

Thank you for creating and maintaining ggtree. It's fantastic. 

This is a silly question for sure, but for purely cosmetic purposes I need to root by the rootedge. To demonstrate what I referring to, I will use figtree.

Here is a tree rooted by "A/California/07/2009"

The same tree rooted by the root-edge:


Interestingly, in figtree when I save the edge-rooted tree and import into ggtree using read.nexus it displays it how I want the tree to be shown. It looks like figtree adds an extra branch with length 0.

How do I achieve this in ggtree? 

Happy to send the tree privately as an example.

messages.author: fa1e85b72b50d60b
messages.subject: Re: Root by geom_rootedge()
parts:
library(ggtree)
library(treeio)

# a tree
tr <- rtree(30)
ggtree(tr) + geom_tiplab()

# reroot
tr2 <- root(tr,"t20")
ggtree(tr2) + geom_tiplab()

tr <- read.newick(textConnection(tr.tree))
ggtree(tr) + geom_tiplab() + 
  geom_nodelab(aes(sunset=!isTip,label=node))

# reroot
tr2 <- root(tr,"t8")
ggtree(tr2) + geom_tiplab() + 
  geom_rootedge(1) +
  geom_rootpoint() + 
  geom_nodelab(aes(sunset=!isTip,label=node))

# a tree was rooted by t8 in Figtree 
tr3.tree <- "((t14:0.2714856754000001,((((((t25:0.8334102174,(t20:0.39790925080000017,t18:0.007299276068999827):0.09190297499):0.34272571019999987,t22:0.2709960358000001):0.6474591909999998,(t26:0.40779504180000004,t29:0.1338664179000002):0.7685050743000001):0.28736298760000034,(t1:0.3364813230000001,(t13:0.33106666549999986,(t23:0.42616967159999986,t7:0.5618903658000001):0.04295982048000013):0.6048565583999999):0.5563307619):0.07426323182999983,(t5:0.5997590907000001,t21:0.6500782318999998):0.015645530310000044):0.3132585990000001,(((((t10:0.9523186538999999,t15:0.5421566151000001):0.3153569300000001,(t3:0.6893716365999998,t11:0.03929186821999986):0.8420525405000001):0.6152872074999998,(t27:0.10896962760000006,t9:0.9772654530000002):0.8999917193):0.10609463320000012,t17:0.9586363818999999):0.7383581949,((((t6:0.6083062644999999,t30:0.031236202219999676):0.11091230530000029,t19:0.6703684888999999):0.4865954457999999,((t16:0.5154582132000001,(t24:0.21793606830000023,t2:0.4253512595000002):0.11822616310000011):0.9075745645,t12:0.49757434799999967):0.25556499230000007):0.35557772730000003,(t4:0.09438740718000016,t28:0.9152109409000002):1.1934045737):0.030357437439999746):0.18173370859999993):0.8577271863):0.17298937565,t8:0.1729893756500001);"
tr3 <- read.newick(textConnection(tr3.tree))
ggtree(tr3) + geom_tiplab() + 
  geom_rootedge(1) +
  geom_rootpoint() + 
  geom_nodelab(aes(sunset=!isTip,label=node))

# convert tree to data table
tr2_data <- as_tibble(tr2)
tr3_data <- as_tibble(tr3)

# get branch.length between root node to t8 
length <- filter(tr3_data, parent == 31, node == 18)

# change branch.length between root node to node 59
tr3_2_data <- mutate(tr3_data, branch.length = ifelse(parent == 31 & node == 59, length$branch.length, branch.length))

# convert data table to tree
tr3_2 <- as.phylo(tr3_2_data)

ggtree(tr3_2) + geom_tiplab() + 
  geom_rootedge(1) +
  geom_rootpoint() + 
  geom_nodelab(aes(sunset=!isTip,label=node))
